children: Jiangsu HUHU to deliver testing, certification, and compliance services; award decision expected in the coming weeks

(“HUHUTECH” or the “Company”), a system integration provider that designs and implements integrated facility management systems and industrial automation monitoring systems for the optoelectronic, and semiconductor, telecom, and logistics industries, today announced that its operating subsidiary, Jiangsu HUHU Electromechanical Technology Co., Ltd. (“Jiangsu HUHU”), has formed a consortium with an East China-based semiconductor facility engineering company to bid on a gas delivery system engineering project for a fab expansion at an integrated circuit manufacturer in China. The total project value is expected to exceed RMB 60 million (more than US$8 million).

Under the consortium agreement, the engineering partner will lead technical design and equipment installation while Jiangsu HUHU will be responsible for testing, certification, and related compliance work. The consortium members are jointly and severally liable to the project owner for performance of the contract. Jiangsu HUHU’s scope represents a portion of the total contract value, and its share will be determined by the final award. The Company expects to provide an update, including Jiangsu HUHU’s share of the contract value, once the bid results are announced.

“Testing and certification sit at the point where a gas system either qualifies for production or it doesn’t, and that is where we have positioned Jiangsu HUHU in this consortium,” said Mr. Yujun Xiao, Chief Executive Officer of HUHUTECH. “By teaming with an experienced engineering partner, we can compete for larger fab expansion projects than we would bid on alone, and this is a model we intend to repeat: pairing our testing, certification, and compliance capabilities with engineering partners on fab projects across China. We look forward to reporting the outcome of this bid.”

is a professional system integration provider that designs and implements integrated facility management systems and industrial automation monitoring systems for the optoelectronic, semiconductor, telecom, and logistics industries. Through its operating subsidiaries in the People’s Republic of China, Japan, the United States, Germany, and Singapore, the Company delivers customized fixed-price engagements spanning project planning, system coding, hardware installation and configuration, and also supplies related equipment. HUHU China holds a first-class construction enterprise qualification and maintains “high-tech enterprise” tax status in the PRC through December 2028. The Company is headquartered in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, China. For more information, visit
